errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.NO_RESPONSE: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: We got an answer we couldn’t read. Try again in a moment.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: Use the full number with the country code, like +91 98450 11234.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: That email doesn’t look right. Check for a typo.
errors.NAME_REQUIRED: Add your name — your team sees it on everything you change.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: Use at least 10 characters for the password.
errors.PHONE_IN_USE_FOR_SIGN_IN: Change this number under Two-step sign-in, which texts it a code first.
errors.SECOND_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Store owners keep two-step sign-in on.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have access to that.
errors.CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.WRONG_CODE_TRIES: That code doesn’t match. {triesLeft} tries left before sign-in is paused.

signIn.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don’t match. Check them, or reset your password.
signIn.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in timed out. Start again.

code.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Your sign-in timed out. Start again.
code.CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.

auth.signInSub: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your store.

notice.signedOut: You’re signed out of every store on this device.
notice.expired: You were signed out after a while without activity. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
notice.noStores: This account doesn’t belong to a store here. Ask the store’s owner to invite you.

auth.twoStepApp: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.resendWait: Didn’t get it? You can ask again in {seconds}s.
auth.codeLength: The code has 6 digits — check it again.
auth.backupSub: One of the 10 codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in, like K4P2-9XQM. Each works once.
auth.backupInvalid: That doesn’t look like a backup code — it’s 8 letters and numbers, like K4P2-9XQM.
auth.enrolPhoneSub: Store owners need it before the store opens — it protects your payouts and your customers’ data. We’ll text you a code each time you sign in.
auth.enrolCodeSub: Type the 6-digit code we texted to {hint}.
auth.codesSub: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
auth.forgotSub: Type the email you sign in with. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotEmailInvalid: Type the email address you sign in with.
auth.forgotSentSub: If {email} has an account, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes. Open it in your browser, choose a new password, then sign in here.
auth.lockedSub: There were 5 wrong passwords or codes in a row, so we paused sign-in for {minutes} minutes to keep your store safe. We’ve emailed the account owner. Reset your password to get back in now.
auth.chooseSub: Signed in as {email}. You belong to {count} stores — pick one to open.
auth.chooseRemoved: You no longer have access to {store} — its owner removed you. Your other stores still work.
auth.signOutBody: Signs you out of every store on this device.

profile.title: My profile
profile.sub: One account for every store you belong to. Changes here apply everywhere you sign in.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHelpChanged: We’ll send a link to the new address. It changes once you click it.
profile.emailSent: We sent a link to {email} — your email changes once you click it.
profile.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
profile.passwordNote: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
profile.passwordShort: The new password needs at least 10 characters.
profile.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords don’t match.
profile.passwordDone: Password changed — you’re signed out everywhere else.
profile.twoStepWhyOwner: Required for store owners — it protects your payouts and customer data. You can change how you get codes, but not turn it off.
profile.twoStepWhyOther: Optional for your role, and strongly recommended. Each sign-in asks for a code as well as your password.
profile.methodAppSub: Codes come from the app on your phone. Works without signal.
profile.methodSmsSub: Codes are texted to your mobile number.
profile.backupSoon: {count} of 10 backup codes left — make new ones soon
profile.newCodesBody: Your old codes stop working straight away.
profile.turnOffBody: Anyone with your password could then sign in as you.
profile.pickTitle: How do you want to get your codes?
profile.pickSmsSub: To the mobile number in Your details
profile.pickSmsNone: Add a mobile number in Your details first
profile.verifyAppTitle: Add this account to your authenticator app, then type the code it shows
profile.setupKey: Setup key — type it into Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar
profile.codesSub: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
profile.signOutOthersBody: Every other device is signed out. This one stays signed in.
